# gyro_container_image (Resource)

An image copied from another registry (Docker Hub, GitHub, Quay or any https registry) into a Gyro Containers (ECS) environment's private registry, without docker push. Creating it imports the image (linux/amd64 only) and waits until the copy is done; destroying it deletes the tag (refused while a service uses it). Use `image` in gyro_container_service. Optional `username`/`password` are sent only for the copy and never stored by Gyro (Terraform keeps them in its state as sensitive values; prefer a read-only token). Limits: 1 running import per environment, 10 per hour, 15 minutes.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copy an image into the environment's private Gyro registry (no docker push), then run it.
resource "gyro_container_image" "web" {
  service_id = 12345 # container environment (gyro-ecs-1)
  source     = "nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.27-alpine"
  repo       = "web"
  tag        = "1.27"
}

# A private image: the token is used only for the copy (prefer a read-only token).
resource "gyro_container_image" "app" {
  service_id = 12345
  source     = "ghcr.io/gyro-ornek/uygulama:1.0"
  username   = "gyro-ornek"
  password   = var.ghcr_read_token
}

resource "gyro_container_service" "web" {
  service_id = 12345
  name       = "web"
  image      = gyro_container_image.web.image
  port       = 8080
  public     = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `service_id` (Number) Container environment (service) id.
- `source` (String) Source image, e.g. nginx:1.27, docker.io/library/redis:7, ghcr.io/gyro-ornek/uygulama:1.0 or name@sha256:... (https registries only). Changing it imports again.

### Optional

- `overwrite` (Boolean) Replace an existing name:tag in the registry (otherwise creation fails with image_exists).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Private source: token / password (used only for the copy, never stored by Gyro).
- `repo` (String) Target name under your registry prefix (lowercase, max 3 levels). Default: last part of the source name.
- `tag` (String) Target tag. Default: the source tag (latest for a digest).
- `username` (String) Private source: username (used only for the copy).

### Read-Only

- `bytes` (Number) Image size in bytes.
- `digest` (String) Manifest digest of the copied linux/amd64 image.
- `id` (String) <service_id>/<repo>:<tag>
- `image` (String) Full image reference for gyro_container_service, e.g. registry.ist.gyrohosting.com/ab12cd/nginx:1.27.
